text: This is auth-vpn: one small, self-hosted doorway from your laptop or CI runner into a private network.

overlay.title: auth-vpn
overlay.body: A self-hosted doorway into your private network

text: Here's the problem. The orders database lives on a private network, so from a laptop, it simply times out.

overlay.text: The database is private: no route from the laptop

text: Connect once, with the token your admin gave you. auth-vpn offers to save it as a profile, and remembers the server's certificate.

overlay.text: First connect: name it, and it's saved

text: Now the private database answers, as if it were running on your machine.

overlay.text: Private services, reachable through the tunnel

text: Need prod as well? Save it once, then pick it from the menu. The stage tunnel steps aside on its own.

overlay.text: Many deployments: pick one, it switches

text: And there's the prod data. Status tells you exactly where you're connected.
Admins get a web dashboard on the same server: connected clients, traffic, and failed sign-ins at a glance.
Every connected device shows up with its tunnel address and traffic. One click on kick, and it's disconnected.
New teammate? Create a token for them in seconds. It's shown once, and the server only keeps its hash.
Or whitelist a CI runner's address range, so it connects without any token at all.

overlay.text: IP whitelist for CI and servers

text: One Go binary, installed in a minute. Find it on GitHub, at adish M 98, slash auth-vpn.

overlay.title: github.com/adishM98/auth-vpn
